title: pipeline.json
description: CRM pipeline — sales opportunities at all stages. 302 records in current dataset. 10 universal fields lock the minimum; 34 optional fields tolerate per-deal metadata variation (notes, expected_close, currency, etc).
_note: 8 of 302 records (2.6%) lack the 5 newer optional fields — likely older deals from before fields were added. Schema accepts this; consumers must use .get() for any non-required field. Pipeline data is also consumed by utils/pipeline_to_bsc.py (v10.323) and the v10.337 activity bridge.
